description.value: One of BC's most visited attractions, set in a rainforest canyon in North Vancouver. Visitors cross a 137-metre suspension bridge high above the Capilano River, walk through the treetop canopy on elevated boardwalks, and follow a cantilevered walkway along the granite cliff face. A free shuttle runs from downtown Vancouver, making it reachable without a car.

address.value: 3735 Capilano Road, North Vancouver, BC V7R 4J1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a major paid tourist attraction in North Vancouver featuring a suspension bridge, Treetops Adventure canopy walk, and Cliffwalk. Food on site is confirmed by three dining options listed in the navigation menu: The Cliff House Restaurant, Loggers' Grill, and On-the-Go. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the website content. Contact info (address, phone, email) confirmed from the website footer.
